theater_event_24_06_01_002:
It is! She really came!
The Diva of Maelstra!!
theater_event_24_06_01_003:
The Big Star of the Land of Opera!
I never dreamed she'd come to Orario—!
theater_event_24_06_01_004:
Sigh... Same voices everywhere. Same dull
script. Even Orario, the center of the world,
is trite.
theater_event_24_06_01_005:
You and I are gracing them with a visit.
This is the least they could do!
theater_event_24_06_01_006:
Excuuuse me? The one they all want to see is
me, me, ME. You're the bonus. Know your place.
theater_event_24_06_01_007:
Who do you think you're mouthing off to? I'm
the all-powerful ruler of beauty, you little
brat...! ...But fine. I'll let it slide.
theater_event_24_06_01_008:
But if you ever embarrass me on that stage...
I'll knock you flat, got it?
theater_event_24_06_01_009: Who do you think you're talking to?
theater_event_24_06_01_010:
I am Harmonia! The one and only shining light,
the absolutely invincible top star!
theater_event_24_06_01_013:
This is my first time in a theater... It's so
fancy, and there are so many Familias here!
theater_event_24_06_01_014:
Indeed. Lord Takemikazuchi is over there...
And even Lord Miach.
theater_event_24_06_01_015:
Lady Hephaistos is over that way too. Every
god and adventurer in Orario's here, huh?
theater_event_24_06_01_016:
Ah... The diva I've heard so much about... To
think I'd ever see Lady Harmonia on stage...
theater_event_24_06_01_017:
I was so very excited, I hardly slept a wink
last night before today finally came... *yawn*
theater_event_24_06_01_018:
Me too! I couldn't sleep, so I reread the
whole heroic tale they're performing today...!
theater_event_24_06_01_019:
Honestly. You two are hopeless
heroic-tale nerds, through and through...
theater_event_24_06_01_020:
Now, now, it's not every day you get a chance
like this. You should enjoy it too, supporter—
theater_event_24_06_01_022:
Ugh, Wallen-whatsit! I had a feeling,
but of course you'd show up too...!
theater_event_24_06_01_023:
Ahaha... Um, you got invited too, Ms. Ais?
Huh, but where's everyone else...?
theater_event_24_06_01_026:
The darkened stage is like the night sky...
and shining upon it are my finest children.
theater_event_24_06_01_027:
Do not miss a single twinkle of the stars
about to unfold before you. I, Aphrodite,
goddess of beauty, promise you won't be bored.
theater_event_24_06_01_028:
I'd heard the rumors, but this really
is Aphrodite's troupe, huh...
theater_event_24_06_01_029:
I hear it's a free show to promote the
troupe... How generous.
theater_event_24_06_01_030:
You're sick of gods' speeches, right? So—
open those eyes wide and enjoy yourselves!
The ultimate stage!
theater_event_24_06_01_031: The heroic tale, "Cadmus and the Songstress"—
theater_event_24_06_02_001:
My voice is hoarse, my sorrow festers, my song
long withered. And yet these tears that slide
down my cheeks refuse to cease.
theater_event_24_06_02_002:
Alas, the fangs draw near—those dreadful jaws!
Though many stars rise and many frosts fall,
the evil one's feasting never ends!
theater_event_24_06_02_003:
O hero. Will you still face
that wicked dragon in battle?
theater_event_24_06_02_004:
Princess, raise your voice once more—a gentle
melody, a peaceful harmony. To reclaim your song,
I bear the grief that shatters the dragon's scale.
theater_event_24_06_02_005:
Sorrow into love. Ruin into eternity. So your
song may outlast time and sing on forever...
now I shall become a dragon-slaying hero!
theater_event_24_06_02_006:
Then take me with you. This song is for you,
who will slay the dragon—...
theater_event_24_06_02_007:
Amazing... I can feel the intensity... It's
like I'm really seeing the ancient past...
theater_event_24_06_02_008:
Ooh, I'm already in tears...! Knowing what
comes next makes my heart ache so...!
Sniff...!
theater_event_24_06_02_009:
That's way too early! And no spoilers, please!
...Though maybe I should've read up
beforehand...
theater_event_24_06_02_010:
("Cadmus and the Songstress" is the most
 classic tale of a hero and a songstress who
 set out to slay an evil dragon.)
theater_event_24_06_02_011:
(She's writing straight on my back with her
 tail...! Back-writing?!)
theater_event_24_06_02_012:
(The hero Cadmus is the greatest of his age.
 And the grieving woman is a peerless
 songstress who weaves miraculous verse...)
theater_event_24_06_02_013:
(The evil dragon devoured many, toyed with
 people, and wrought endless ruin—and the hero
 and songstress hunt it down. However...)
theater_event_24_06_02_014:
O hero. O dragon slayer worthy of slaying me.
I shall not die alone! Your life comes with
me!
theater_event_24_06_02_015:
I shall devour your name along with your soul,
and make my infamy the song that outlasts
time!
theater_event_24_06_02_016:
I will not allow it, dragon! Even if you steal
my name, I shall not bow to ruin!
theater_event_24_06_02_017:
Princess, I beg you, sing! A guardian's
blessing beyond any spirit's miracle! Make my
grief a blade to shatter its scale!!
theater_event_24_06_02_018:
Ahh, the finale is at last upon us...!
With the songstress's power, the hero lands
his final blow...!
theater_event_24_06_02_019:
Yes...! Trading his own life
to slay the terrible dragon...!
theater_event_24_06_02_021:
Huh...? Princess, you need not falter. This
sword shall protect you! Now, with my life, I
shall put an end to despair...!!
theater_event_24_06_02_025:
Hey, hey, what's going on?
Don't tell me she forgot her lines?!
theater_event_24_06_02_028:
The same plot every time, the same trite
tears. I'm sure even the gods up in the
heavens are bored!
theater_event_24_06_02_029:
Uh, they're really not, though?!
P-Princess! Speak not so, and sing—
theater_event_24_06_02_030:
Tragic heroines are so last era! If the hero
falls, I'll take up the sword! I cast aside my
song and slay the evil dragon myself!
theater_event_24_06_02_032:
Bare your fangs, dragon! Rattle your claws!
The scales I break are your grief! My war cry
outroars any dragon! Have at thee!!
theater_event_24_06_02_034:
Seeing the hero in peril, the songstress takes
on the dragon...? I-is this truly the script?!
theater_event_24_06_02_035:
I-I don't know... I've never seen "Cadmus and
the Songstress" like this...
theater_event_24_06_02_036: ...I've never seen such a bright, fun story!!
theater_event_24_06_02_037:
That IDIOT...!!! —Music! Play! Throw some good
music on it and power through!!
theater_event_24_06_02_038:
I'll go down with Harmonia!!
That invincible stage hog!
theater_event_24_06_02_039: Music, right here! And singing too!
theater_event_24_06_02_040:
The songstress's song! Woven in such a way!
That verse becomes this, and that, and
overlaps right here...!
theater_event_24_06_02_041:
What an interpretation! A brand-new discovery!
Ahh, it deepens! It inspires!!!
theater_event_24_06_02_044:
She rewrote the plot... A tragedy into a
comedy. Despair into hope.
theater_event_24_06_02_045:
The world wants not a "manufactured hero," but
a "heretical hero"... Only on stage, but not
bad. Not bad at all, "Queen of Opera."
theater_event_24_06_02_046:
Behold our Absolute Opera!
Gods, look upon us! Past the dragon's corpse,
the curtain rises on a legend!
theater_event_24_06_02_047:
No need for tragedy, no need for horror! A
comedy suits us just fine! Take the fool's
hand and come, come, come!!
theater_event_24_06_02_048:
—Such is our Absolute Opera. Tonight's tale
ends here. May a new legend be woven on the
next page.
theater_event_24_06_02_049:
So that's... Harmonia, the diva of Maelstra,
the Land of Opera...!
theater_event_24_06_03_001:
Master Bell!! That was sooooooo
wonderful a play, was it not?!
theater_event_24_06_03_002:
Yeah! It was my first time seeing a play,
but... showing a story in such an incredible
way... what is this feeling?
theater_event_24_06_03_003:
When I think about Ms. Harmonia, my heart
races... I think I might've become a fan...!
theater_event_24_06_03_005:
Didn't Lord Hermes say he'd be selling
the diva's "merch" after the show?
theater_event_24_06_03_006: Really?! I-I might want to buy some...!
theater_event_24_06_03_007:
I want some too! Ahh, so this is what the gods
call having a "fave"... feeling she's
"precious"!
theater_event_24_06_03_008:
Grrr!! For heroic-tale nerds like Bell,
today's show was way too potent!!!
theater_event_24_06_03_009:
It's only fan feelings, but to catch the eye
of Mr. Bell, of all blockheads...! That
actress is far too dangerous!
theater_event_24_06_03_010:
Ms. Harmonia?! But the play's over,
so why is she... Oh, could it be?!
theater_event_24_06_03_011:
Might this be what they call a "curtain
call"?! I am so moved, so thrilled!
theater_event_24_06_03_012:
Thank you all for coming today, Orario!
No need to ask how you liked the show, I see.
theater_event_24_06_03_013:
Lady Harmonia, it was the finest show
eveeeeer!
theater_event_24_06_03_015:
Thank you, thank you♪ Now, changing the
subject, mind if I share some news that might
surprise you a little?
theater_event_24_06_03_017: I, Harmonia... am retiring as of today's show!
theater_event_24_06_03_019:
Refunds for the paid shows starting tomorrow,
complaints, all that messy stuff—take it all
to our useless goddess!
theater_event_24_06_03_021:
So, everyone, adios, adieu, goodbyeee!
Thank you so much for all your support!
theater_event_24_06_03_025:
Lady Harmonia... I haven't even sent a fan
letter or flowers yet...
theater_event_24_06_03_026:
The day I got a fave, my fave vanished. The
day I got a fave, my fave vanished... Whaaat
even is thaaat??
theater_event_24_06_03_029:
Some gods say a fave's "graduation" is a death
of the soul. Best to leave them be for a
while.
theater_event_24_06_03_030:
What utterly useless knowledge... Hm? Lady
Sword Princess, what's wrong? You look lost in
thought.
theater_event_24_06_03_031:
...The Diva of Maelstra...
wasn't singing her own songs...
theater_event_24_06_03_032:
Whaaat?! You mean... she was lip-syncing?!
Are you sure you didn't see wrong?!
theater_event_24_06_03_033:
Her mouth was just a little off... Someone
else was singing, and she was pretending to
sing along... I think that's right.
theater_event_24_06_03_034:
The senses of a first-tier adventurer, huh...
None of us noticed a thing.
theater_event_24_06_03_035:
Ms. Harmonia, lip-syncing...? Nooo way. So
that Harmonia was an illusion, and Ms.
Harmonia isn't retiring after all. Yaaay.
theater_event_24_06_03_036:
Don't run from reality, Bell! Hmm... But is
this lip-sync thing connected to her
retirement announcement?
theater_event_24_06_03_037:
You could read into it all day. For starters,
why would Aphrodite make a "diva who doesn't
sing" her troupe's leading lady—
theater_event_24_06_03_038:
Lady Harmoniaaa! Please wait!
Please, go back to Lady Aphrodite...!
theater_event_24_06_03_039:
No way! I'm breaking free of her clutches! I'm
going to live my own life, unbound by any
god!!
theater_event_24_06_03_041: —Oh, found myself a nice little mark!
theater_event_24_06_03_045:
—Bland boy, think of it as a good deed and
play along! I'll give you an autograph later.
Got it? You got it? Good!
theater_event_24_06_03_046:
Huh? Ah... An autograph?! From Ms. Harmonia?!
G-got it!!
theater_event_24_06_03_047:
Lady Harmonia, please stop this supreme
ultra-mega selfishness! Lady Aphrodite is
gonna be super-duper mega-mad, you know?!
theater_event_24_06_03_049:
It's not like I'm quitting because the stage
is dull and I'm sick of staring at trite
audiences with faces like lumpy vegetables!
theater_event_24_06_03_050:
That sounds exactly like how you really
feel...
theater_event_24_06_03_051:
Tell that dimwit goddess this. I'm in no
condition to stand on a stage anymore, no
matter what!
theater_event_24_06_03_054:
That's right!
Inside me right now is—the fruit of my love
with my darling!
theater_event_24_06_03_055:
That's right! Ms. Harmonia and I are having a
baby—wait, WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAT?!
theater_event_24_06_04_001:
Wh-wh-wh-what is the meaning of this, Mr.
Bell?! Lili never heard anything about a
baby!!
theater_event_24_06_04_002:
Are you planning to rebel against a virgin
goddess's Familia and start a resistance?!
theater_event_24_06_04_003:
No, no, NO!!!
Nobody's having anybody's baby!
theater_event_24_06_04_004: Bell... When did you become a dad?
theater_event_24_06_04_006:
A SCOOOOOOP!! Genius actress Harmonia and the
ever-frisky bunny, Little Rookie—a shotgun
wedding?!
theater_event_24_06_04_008: Where did you even come from?!
theater_event_24_06_04_009:
Ah-wawawawa... Lady Harmonia and Master
Bell... did such and such things together
when— aaaaaaahhh!!
theater_event_24_06_04_011:
Wh-why, you...! A virgin goddess's follower,
and you dared Firebolt our brightest star—!!
theater_event_24_06_04_015: Lady Hestia, what do we do?!
theater_event_24_06_04_016:
Punish Mr. Bell first, or condemn him first,
or weep tears of blood and run him through
with a yandere sword first!!!
theater_event_24_06_04_017:
Calm down, supporter! I know your brain's
broken, but come back to us! It's the diva's
bluff! Gods can tell when someone's lying!
theater_event_24_06_04_018:
First Eina the receptionist, now Harmonia the
great actress... Why does every woman I love
fall prey to the Little Rookie?!
theater_event_24_06_04_019: RAAAAAH! Death to the rabbit! No mercy!!!
theater_event_24_06_04_020:
Ngh, the gawkers are piling on too! This is
getting out of hand!! Bell, I'll handle things
here—you all run!
theater_event_24_06_04_022:
Oh my, is this a lovers' escape? Now it's
getting fun! I'm in your hands, darling♪
theater_event_24_06_04_023: Please don't pour oil on the fire!!
theater_event_24_06_04_024:
Um... Bell, Dad?
Or should I call you Papa Bell...?
theater_event_24_06_04_025:
Wallen-whatsit! Stop being an airhead and go
after them! You're their bodyguard AND Bell's
chaperone! I'm counting on youuu!
theater_event_24_06_04_028:
Hah, hah... I'm beat! A game of tag with
adventurers? What an experience! Truth really
is stranger than the stage!
theater_event_24_06_04_029:
Isn't it "stranger than fiction"...? Gawkers
attracted more gawkers—by the end it was like
a Monster Party...
theater_event_24_06_04_030:
But, Ms. Ais, is it really okay for you to
hide us in the Loki Familia's home?
theater_event_24_06_04_031:
I told Loony and the gatekeepers... Riveria
might scold me... but nobody's home right now.
theater_event_24_06_04_032:
R-really? It's kinda scary... Mostly in the
sense of a certain Thousand Elf...
theater_event_24_06_04_033:
...But who'd have thought you were the
"Sword Princess"? And this bland boy is the
"Little Rookie"?
theater_event_24_06_04_034:
That's me! I've got the luck! Imagine running
into people more famous than me!
theater_event_24_06_04_035:
M-Ms. Ais, sure, but I'm not anyone like
that...
theater_event_24_06_04_036: Hmm? Are you being modest or something?
theater_event_24_06_04_037:
I don't think that kind of humility is a
virtue.
theater_event_24_06_04_039:
If you don't properly grasp your own standing
and reputation, it makes people unhappy. You,
and the people around you.
theater_event_24_06_04_041:
Yes. It can hurt the ones who keep trying and
trying, gritting their teeth and pushing past
their limits, and still can't get "there."
theater_event_24_06_04_042:
That's why I live with my chest puffed out
so far I nearly fall over backward!
theater_event_24_06_04_043:
Back straight, heels clicking, like I'm the
center of the world! Look upon me and worship,
veggies! ...Like that!
theater_event_24_06_04_046:
That's not it. I'm the only one who knows the
road I've walked. If it's nothing to be ashamed
of... then hiding it would be unfair to me, too.
theater_event_24_06_04_047:
(...So this is an actress.
 Or is it just her...?)
theater_event_24_06_04_048:
Listen, Little Rookie. You're famous.
A rising rabbit in the hottest city around,
the world-record holder for leveling.
theater_event_24_06_04_049:
Your name might ring out across the world even
louder than mine. You may be a "kind person,"
but you're also an "amazing person."
theater_event_24_06_04_051:
So stand tall, at least as tall as me.
There must be plenty of people who look up
to you already.
theater_event_24_06_04_052:
Mm... I think Bell could be a little more...
big and bold, too...
theater_event_24_06_04_054:
Oh, that look again—I've seen it a million
times. What, did you fall for me for real?
theater_event_24_06_04_056:
No, no, I didn't!! I just... I'm glad
I became Ms. Harmonia's fan, that's all...
theater_event_24_06_04_057:
Thanks. Well then! When your fave asks a
favor, you'll listen, sobbing and trembling
with honor, right?
theater_event_24_06_04_058:
Huh...? I don't know about sobbing...
b-but what is it?
theater_event_24_06_04_059: I want to give you two a quest!
theater_event_24_06_04_061:
Yes! The job: be my bodyguards and Orario tour
guides! —Plan me the perfect date, darling♪
theater_event_24_06_05_001:
What a refreshing morning! Good day, world!
You're shining second only to me today!
theater_event_24_06_05_002:
Come on, darling, and Ais too!
Attend to me properly, okay?
theater_event_24_06_05_003:
Please, I'm begging you, stop calling me
darling... I can't believe we're really giving
her a tour of Orario...
theater_event_24_06_05_004:
My first time... being a guide...
I'm nervous...
theater_event_24_06_05_006:
Oh? The Little Rookie's with the diva! Is it
true they already have three secret kids and
live together?!
theater_event_24_06_05_007:
How fast can he possibly be? This is messed
up! And the Sword Princess is with them too?!
What the heck?!!!
theater_event_24_06_05_009:
That's the price of fame. But if we've got an
audience... maybe you two should dress
the part?
theater_event_24_06_05_011:
Especially you, darling! If you stand next to
me dressed like some nobody, it'll tarnish the
name of a great actress like me!
theater_event_24_06_05_012:
Um, I'll do anything...
Just please, spare me the "darling"...
theater_event_24_06_05_013:
Come on, over here! I'll give you the ultimate
Orario-style makeover!
theater_event_24_06_05_014:
Mmm, lovely! Ais, you look just like a lady
knight from a heroic tale! Totally stunning!
theater_event_24_06_05_016:
Um, are you sure it's okay
for us to keep clothes this expensive?
theater_event_24_06_05_017:
Of course! In exchange, I'm going to have all
the fun I can today. So guide me well, got it?
theater_event_24_06_05_018:
Ooh! Amazing, not bad, Orario!
So many rare goods from the Dungeon!
theater_event_24_06_05_019:
I love these elixir cosmetics!
I'm taking ten boxes home!
theater_event_24_06_05_020: M-Ms. Harmonia... you're still buying more?
theater_event_24_06_05_021:
What are you talking about? We've barely
started.
theater_event_24_06_05_023: This might be harder than a Dungeon quest...
theater_event_24_06_05_024:
Mmm, delicious! Total junk food, but I love
it! You've won me over, Jyaga Maru-kun!
theater_event_24_06_05_025:
Right? Jyaga Maru-kun smells great, tastes
great, and fills you up—the ultimate field
ration!
theater_event_24_06_05_026:
I'm glad you like it... When you think Orario,
you think Jyaga Maru-kun.
theater_event_24_06_05_027:
You're scarfing those down—do you like them
too, Ais?
theater_event_24_06_05_028:
Jyaga Maru-kun is... justice. Jyaga Maru-kun
is... love. Jyaga Maru-kun... will save
the world...
theater_event_24_06_05_029: Hey, is this girl an airhead?
theater_event_24_06_05_031:
—There! THERE THEY AAAAAAARE!!
Lady Harmonia and the villain Bell Cranel!!
Spotted!!
theater_event_24_06_05_033: Our pursuers are here! Let's run, darling!
theater_event_24_06_05_034: Is this really going to get sorted out later?!
theater_event_24_06_06_001: Think we're safe this far out?
theater_event_24_06_06_002:
Um... wouldn't it be better to go back once?
Everyone seemed worried...
theater_event_24_06_06_003:
Well, yeah. I do kinda feel bad for making
more work for the rest of the troupe...
theater_event_24_06_06_004:
But that useless goddess is only panicking
because her crowd-drawing panda ran off. No
need to worry about her.
theater_event_24_06_06_005: Th-that's quite a way to talk about a god...
theater_event_24_06_06_006:
I've earned the right! You have no idea how
much she's put me through with her ridiculous
demands!
theater_event_24_06_06_007:
Rehearsals late into the night, day after day,
and any free time spent on interviews
and greeting patrons.
theater_event_24_06_06_008:
On tour, it's months of rattling around in
carriages, east and west... How dare she cram
us into such a murderous schedule!
theater_event_24_06_06_010:
Don't gods have any feelings for people?
What about your patron gods?
theater_event_24_06_06_011:
Not my goddess... Lady Hestia's always
thinking about me...
theater_event_24_06_06_013:
Hmm. Sounds better than mine. I'm jealous.
Seriously, never get stuck with a selfish
"goddess of beauty" as your patron—
theater_event_24_06_06_014: Find her! She can't have gotten far!
theater_event_24_06_06_015:
...Persistent, aren't they? Even if they are
my troupe. Hey, is there somewhere quiet we
can talk?
theater_event_24_06_06_016:
Um... Oh, I know.
Ms. Ais, what about that place?
theater_event_24_06_06_018:
Wooooow! Oh, this is good, this is good!
All of Orario dyed in the sunset...!
What a view!
theater_event_24_06_06_019:
It's beautiful, isn't it? I was moved too,
when Ms. Ais showed me. It looks just like a
scene from a story...
theater_event_24_06_06_020:
—"Twilight, who asks who goes there? The
guardian of water stands here. Pray tell her I
go now to wipe away her crimson tears."
theater_event_24_06_06_021:
Oh! That's "Fulland of Water and Light"! The
sunset scene where the knight returns in
triumph to the weeping spirit...
theater_event_24_06_06_022:
Hehe... You got that from one line? You're
something else. It's not even a famous scene.
theater_event_24_06_06_023:
That's... because your acting is amazing, Ms.
Harmonia. The scenery I imagined reading the
book just came alive, so vividly...
theater_event_24_06_06_024:
I'm... really glad I met you on stage, Ms.
Harmonia. I never dreamed I'd get so hooked.
theater_event_24_06_06_025: Glad you met me on stage, huh...
theater_event_24_06_06_027:
Nothing. Nothing at all. More importantly, is
this your secret rendezvous spot?
theater_event_24_06_06_028:
R-rendezvous?! No! This is just where
Ms. Ais trained me!
theater_event_24_06_06_029:
Thanks to that... I was able to become
an "adventurer."
theater_event_24_06_06_030:
That was... because you worked hard, Bell.
You were amazing.
theater_event_24_06_06_031:
Th-that's not... Ah, no, wait... no modesty,
right. Um... th-thank you very much!
theater_event_24_06_06_032:
Hehe... I don't quite get it, but this is
where it all started for you two? A memory
you'll never forget?
theater_event_24_06_06_033:
...Yes. It's one of my most
precious places...
theater_event_24_06_06_035:
I don't have a place where it all started
anymore... so I'm a little envious.
theater_event_24_06_06_037:
...Gotcha! Show a little bit of shadow and
you're so much more alluring, right? You're
such a kid, darling.
theater_event_24_06_06_039:
A great actress like me is a woman of mystery!
Anyway, tell me more about you two, okay?
theater_event_24_06_06_040:
What you've done, what adventures you've
pulled through... I want to know.
theater_event_24_06_07_001:
Mr. Bell's letter saying he was safe arrived
first thing this morning, but... what is this
about being Lady Harmonia's guide?!
theater_event_24_06_07_002:
And dragging in the Sword Princess, a
first-tier adventurer?! What kind of rich snob
is she?! Is she invincible or something?!
theater_event_24_06_07_003:
Way more outrageous than any noble. That
diva's a wild one. Is that what it means to be
an actress?
theater_event_24_06_07_004:
Hmm, I think it's less about her being an
actress and more about her being the follower of
Aphrodite, who knows nothing but selfishness.
theater_event_24_06_07_005:
Aphrodite's every bit as headstrong as that
diva. Or really, just plain outrageous.
theater_event_24_06_07_006:
She is a "goddess of beauty" like Lady Ishtar
and Lady Freya... but is her personality
that different?
theater_event_24_06_07_007:
Different. Totally different. How do I put
it... She's kinda small-fry.
theater_event_24_06_07_009:
She was something else in the heavens. She'd
abuse her Charm to do whatever she wanted, then
get caught cheating and land in hot water...
theater_event_24_06_07_010:
Less pouring oil on the fire, more like she's
the bomb herself. Her children must have it
rough, in more ways than one.
theater_event_24_06_07_011:
I see. So you approved Sir Bell's quest
out of sympathy, then?
theater_event_24_06_07_012:
It's not just sympathy... The diva seemed like
she was pushing herself too hard, and I got a
little worried.
theater_event_24_06_07_013:
Pushing herself...? Even after leaving the
stage, she seemed so very poised...
theater_event_24_06_07_014:
At a glance, sure, but, hmm...
I wonder what Aphrodite makes of all this—
theater_event_24_06_07_015:
Haaaaaaaaah?! She's running around under the
protection of Hestia's kid and the Sword
Princess?!
theater_event_24_06_07_016:
Yes... They know the terrain, and we can't
catch her...
theater_event_24_06_07_017:
That idiot princess! Throwing everything away—
what is she thinking?!
theater_event_24_06_07_018:
Why should I—the strongest, super-gorgeous
beauty of all three worlds—have to bow my head
to a bunch of patrons?!
theater_event_24_06_07_019:
What shall we do? I can't forgive that rabbit
for laying hands on Lady Harmonia, but against
the Sword Princess, we haven't got a prayer...
theater_event_24_06_07_020:
Sigh... I finally got the "plan" this far,
and she's gone and thrown it all into chaos...
theater_event_24_06_07_021: ...Fine. If that's how it's going to be...
theater_event_24_06_07_022:
Then I won't be picky about my methods either.
Whatever Harmonia may be thinking—
theater_event_24_06_07_023:
—Ahh, that was delicious! The Benevolent
Mistress is the best! Better than any fancy
restaurant in any other city!
theater_event_24_06_07_024:
I thought Orario was all about the Dungeon,
but the food's seriously good too! Who knew!
theater_event_24_06_07_025:
Thank you very much.
Please come again, Ms. Harmonia.
theater_event_24_06_07_026:
And Bell... next time, you'll tell me properly
why you were grinning like a fool with a
flower on each arm, won't you?
theater_event_24_06_07_027:
Th-this is a quest! Sure, as a fan, eating
with her was the best time ever, but...!
theater_event_24_06_07_028:
Ohhh, a fan, are you? So Ms. Harmonia is your
"fave," Bell. Huh. Hmm. I see.
theater_event_24_06_07_029: (Uh-oh, I think I just dug my own grave...)
theater_event_24_06_07_032:
I don't know any Bell who eavesdrops on people
talking to themselves. Now, please come again!
theater_event_24_06_07_034:
...Hmm. Of course—he's the world-record
holder. No girl's going to leave a catch like
that alone~
theater_event_24_06_07_035:
What about you, Ais? That bland-looking,
slightly odd boy—what do you think of him?
theater_event_24_06_07_036:
Bell...?
I... like him. He's like a bunny.
theater_event_24_06_07_037:
When I'm feeling down, he cheers me up.
So...
theater_event_24_06_07_039:
Ms. Harmonia, Bell looks at you with sparkling
eyes... I'm a little jealous, too.
theater_event_24_06_07_042:
Nothing.
Come on, let's go chase after our darling.
theater_event_24_06_08_001:
We doubled back and boldly came to Central
Park, but... looking up at Babel again, it's
really huge, huh.
theater_event_24_06_08_002: I thought so too... when I was little.
theater_event_24_06_08_003:
When you were little? Ais,
how long have you been diving the Dungeon?
theater_event_24_06_08_005:
You're kidding?! Since that young...?
...Weren't you scared of the monsters?
theater_event_24_06_08_006:
...There was something I had to do...
more than I was scared.
theater_event_24_06_08_007:
...You're on another level. First-tier
adventurers really are. You live in a
different world from us actors.
theater_event_24_06_08_009:
Off the stage, I'm just a little girl...
Not "the real thing" like you two—
theater_event_24_06_08_010:
Listen. You will become an arrogant, insolent
villainess.
theater_event_24_06_08_011:
You'll call yourself a "diva" though you
cannot sing—an "actress" who captivates
everyone.
theater_event_24_06_08_012:
From now until eternity, you'll never be able
to leave the stage. No matter what happens—
theater_event_24_06_08_015:
...Anyway, people like us should just do
whatever we want on the stage we're good at.
Toss out humility and modesty.
theater_event_24_06_08_016:
Well... coming from someone who retired,
that's not very convincing. Right now I'm just
a selfish little girl, plain and simple.
theater_event_24_06_08_018:
...Right. I'll ask.
Let me do it.
theater_event_24_06_08_019:
Um, Ms. Harmonia! The reason you suddenly
retired from the stage... is it because
something's bothering you about singing?
theater_event_24_06_08_021:
Ms. Ais told me. That you're a "diva,"
but you weren't singing...
theater_event_24_06_08_022:
You can act so amazingly, and you're so proud
of the stage, but you retired anyway... I
thought there had to be a reason...
theater_event_24_06_08_023:
...Adventurers really are unfair. No—amazing.
No one's ever noticed before...
theater_event_24_06_08_025:
It's true, I can't sing. No matter what.
Actors fool everyone so they can captivate
everyone. But...
theater_event_24_06_08_026:
This "lie" of mine is pathetic and ridiculous,
and I can't fool even myself anymore...
Honestly, it's just gotten to be too much.
theater_event_24_06_08_028:
That's right. So I'm done telling "lies,"
and I'll become some other me, not a "diva"—
theater_event_24_06_08_031:
Don't be ridiculous, Harmonia. Running away
from the stage? That's truly a "comedy no one
would laugh at."
theater_event_24_06_08_032:
You'd lost everything... a pitiful little
girl. Why do you think I made you my follower?
theater_event_24_06_08_040:
I'm not your doll! I'm not a tool for earning
you money and fame! I'm not an accessory
to decorate a goddess!!
theater_event_24_06_08_041:
Fine, I'll say it! I hated being with you!
It's suffocating! A goddess who knows what I
"used to be"—!
theater_event_24_06_08_042:
What you "used to be" was meant for
"this very moment," wasn't it?
theater_event_24_06_08_045:
Sing. Your "song," with all your life in it...
right here.
theater_event_24_06_08_046:
Th-there's no way I can do that!!
Why? Why would you say that?!
theater_event_24_06_08_047: You know exactly what my "song" is—!!
theater_event_24_06_08_048:
...She won't budge. Not an inch.
In that case,
theater_event_24_06_08_049: if you can't sing, I'll make you sing—
theater_event_24_06_08_054:
You two aren't my targets. I have no intention
of bending you.
theater_event_24_06_08_056:
N-no, no...!
I don't want that "song"—...
theater_event_24_06_08_058:
Ms. Harmonia...? Hang in there!
Lady Aphrodite, what did you do?!
theater_event_24_06_08_059:
It's time for the "plan." What begins now is
the overture. My long-cherished dream—
theater_event_24_06_08_060:
...!!
This is... this is Ms. Harmonia's song.
theater_event_24_06_08_062:
Why has Ms. Harmonia never sung
such an amazing song before...
theater_event_24_06_08_069:
It's after Ms. Harmonia...?!
I won't let it!!
theater_event_24_06_09_002:
Eeek?!
Why is there a dragon in Orario?!
theater_event_24_06_09_011:
I couldn't land a fatal blow.
So all I could do was blow it into the sky...
theater_event_24_06_09_014:
The flesh and magic stone you'd need to
destroy were "lost" ages ago.
theater_event_24_06_09_024:
So it seems. The intel was dubious, but...
the rehearsal went well, then.
theater_event_24_06_09_026:
Yes, we'll do our part in the goddess's plan.
This time, we kill the mighty dragon that
stole a hero's name.
theater_event_24_07_01_001:
—The ancient age.
Long ago, before we gods had descended
to the mortal world.
theater_event_24_07_01_002:
An evil dragon born from the deep darkness of
the Dungeon crawled up to the surface and
wrought endless destruction.
theater_event_24_07_01_003:
Rising against it were a single hero and the
peerless songstress who lovingly supported
him.
theater_event_24_07_01_004:
Empowered by her mystic song, the hero
cornered the evil dragon and gave his whole
life to destroy its body. But—
theater_event_24_07_01_009:
—That happened last night?!
What became of this unknown monster?
theater_event_24_07_01_010:
Ms. Ais drove it off...
But...
theater_event_24_07_01_011:
She said it didn't feel like she hit
anything... and Lady Aphrodite said it would
come back...
theater_event_24_07_01_013: Um, how is Lady Harmonia faring...?
theater_event_24_07_01_014: She's still asleep. But she looks pale...
theater_event_24_07_01_016:
She stormed out just now, fuming. Said she was
going to grill that beauty goddess.
theater_event_24_07_01_018:
Even for you, using divine power to force your
child into something so reckless?
Have you lost your mind?!
theater_event_24_07_01_019:
Quit your squawking. I have my own way of
doing things. A shrimp like you has no
business telling me how to raise my children.
theater_event_24_07_01_020:
Raise them?! I hear you summoned trouble too!
And what the heck was that dragon that fell
out of the sky?!
theater_event_24_07_01_021:
...You saw "Cadmus and the Songstress,"
didn't you?
theater_event_24_07_01_022:
The show from two days ago?
I did, but...
theater_event_24_07_01_023:
The dragon that came down yesterday was... a
scale shed from the evil dragon in that opera—
a vanguard sent after the songstress, say.
theater_event_24_07_01_024:
...?! But in the heroic tale, the evil dragon
and the hero took each other down, didn't
they?!
theater_event_24_07_01_025:
In the diva's version, she beat it
herself, but...
theater_event_24_07_01_026:
For that girl... an ending where a song drove
the hero to his death must have been
unacceptable.
theater_event_24_07_01_028:
In the "ancient age," the songstress at
Cadmus's side had a gift surpassing even the
spirits'. The power of song.
theater_event_24_07_01_029:
A fifth wellspring of strength and life... the
voice of "Supreme Harmony." The mortal world's
most precious "unknown."
theater_event_24_07_01_030:
...! Don't tell me it's the same as
Miach's girl, Cassandra...?
theater_event_24_07_01_031:
And the true evil dragon devoured the flesh of
the hero Cadmus, who'd been Linked with the
songstress's power—
theater_event_24_07_01_032:
and of all things, it gained the songstress's
gift. Even after its body was destroyed, it
lived on.
theater_event_24_07_01_033:
As the evil dragon that stole the hero's name
and wears it as its own: "Cadmus."
theater_event_24_07_01_035:
It's like a child's soul that can't return to
the heavens and wanders. The nasty part is its
monster instincts and urge to destroy remain.
theater_event_24_07_01_036:
That clingy, stalker, crap-for-brains dragon
roamed the skies, hunting for the songstress's
"Supreme Harmony," the source of its gift.
theater_event_24_07_01_037:
...Hey, hey. Don't tell me the "punchline"
of this story is...
theater_event_24_07_01_038:
Correct. Harmonia is a descendant of the
ancient songstress. Of the true bloodline— the
legend reborn, without a doubt.
theater_event_24_07_01_039:
And on that day. Her tenth birthday.
The evil dragon appeared in her hometown—
and burned everything to the ground.
theater_event_24_07_01_040:
So it could devour the "songstress"
left behind in this age—
theater_event_24_07_01_042:
—As she grew, her "song" came to hold abundant
magic, and the evil dragon Cadmus didn't miss
it.
theater_event_24_07_01_043:
I happened to be there, and I Charmed the
dragon for a moment, so I managed to save
Harmonia, at least—
theater_event_24_07_01_044:
But she was so young, and she'd lost her
family and her whole village... She was
completely broken.
theater_event_24_07_01_046:
The dragon must have understood by instinct.
That the blood of the descendant, Harmonia,
would grant it even greater power.
theater_event_24_07_01_047:
W-wait a second...! So you're saying the
diva's been carrying that kind of trauma this
whole time?!
theater_event_24_07_01_048:
A girl who smiles and shines her way
through every show like that...
theater_event_24_07_01_050:
I Charmed her.
So she could never leave the stage.
theater_event_24_07_01_052:
—Mr. Bell!! It's terrible!
Lady Harmonia's gone!
theater_event_24_07_01_053:
What...?!
No way, in that state—where could she...!
theater_event_24_07_01_054:
...Bell.
Let's split up and look for her.
theater_event_24_07_02_003:
Cry later! I don't know how long my Charm will
hold on something that unstable!
We're getting out of here, now!!
theater_event_24_07_02_010:
If you insist it's your sin, then atone for it
with your own hands!
theater_event_24_07_02_012: —And if you haven't the resolve for even that,
theater_event_24_07_02_015:
Listen. You will become an arrogant, insolent
villainess.
theater_event_24_07_02_016:
You'll call yourself a "diva" though you
cannot sing—an "actress" who captivates
everyone.
theater_event_24_07_02_017:
From now until eternity, you'll never be able
to leave the stage. No matter what happens—
theater_event_24_07_02_019:
The magic on me! That ugly Charm!
Ahaha... hahahahaha...!
theater_event_24_07_02_022:
...Don't. Don't look...
Don't look at meee...!
theater_event_24_07_02_026:
No, I don't want this...! It's not true, I'm
not an actress...! I'm a murderer who killed
everyone...!
theater_event_24_07_02_029:
What a sorry sight. After all that cheek,
this is what's under the mask?
theater_event_24_07_02_032:
"Only I can give myself orders... I choose my
own theater." That's what you've always said.
theater_event_24_07_02_033:
What a disgrace. You can't even live by your
own philosophy. How utterly pathetic.
theater_event_24_07_02_034:
No...! That's not true! That wasn't "me"!
The goddess made me say all of it!!
It wasn't "me"!!
theater_event_24_07_02_035:
—Don't give me that crap!!! Don't throw away
the script! Your script belongs to you and you
alone!!
theater_event_24_07_02_036:
Every last bit of it was a jewel buried inside
you!
theater_event_24_07_02_037:
Get up! Up! Stand up and sing!! The one who'll
slay that ridiculous dragon is none other than
your "song"!
theater_event_24_07_02_040:
Goddess, why are you just standing there
watching?! Make her stop!
theater_event_24_07_02_042:
They'll all disappear! If I sing, everyone'll
be gone, just like my village!
theater_event_24_07_02_045:
Keep your hands out of this, brat!
If you're going to get in my way—kneel!
theater_event_24_07_02_051:
Wh-what is with that boy~?!
Why doesn't my Charm work on him?!
theater_event_24_07_02_052:
Hestia, what on earth did you do to your
child?!
theater_event_24_07_02_053:
I didn't do anything...
Long story short, Bell's just immune to Charm.
theater_event_24_07_02_054:
Immune?! Not even a god is like that! That's
nothing but a goddess-of-beauty killer~~!!
theater_event_24_07_02_058:
Wh-why are monsters
falling out of the sky?!
theater_event_24_07_02_059: Who cares! There's only one thing to do!
theater_event_24_07_02_060:
We protect the innocent!
Everyone, let's go!!
theater_event_24_07_03_001:
Just as I thought... It doesn't feel like
I'm hitting anything.
theater_event_24_07_03_002:
They're just scales shed by a bodiless dragon.
Of course.
theater_event_24_07_03_003:
Lady Aphrodite...?! And Lady Hestia too! I'm
terribly sorry—right now, Lady Harmonia...!
theater_event_24_07_03_004:
I know! I know Harmonia ran off!
She's still on her lovers' escape with
Bell Cranel!
theater_event_24_07_03_005:
A lovers'! Escape?! Master Bell and Lady
Harmonia! S-so Master Bell truly is her
darling, with seven children?!
theater_event_24_07_03_006:
Haruhime, I'm dead serious, please don't go
off the rails right now. ...And Aphrodite,
quit phrasing things weird.
theater_event_24_07_03_007:
Hmph!! What I hate most is a man who
won't do what I say!
theater_event_24_07_03_008:
...Lady Hestia.
Can I go after Ms. Harmonia too?
theater_event_24_07_03_010:
While I was searching, I asked Loki. Why I was
the only one left on the surface. And about
Lady Aphrodite's... "plan."
theater_event_24_07_03_011:
I can explain to Bell what's "about to
happen." So...
theater_event_24_07_03_013:
What on earth is going on here?! And what
"plan"?! One baffling thing after another...
theater_event_24_07_03_014:
—There you are, Aphrodite.
Safe to assume things are already in motion?
theater_event_24_07_03_015:
...Yes.
It's locked on to Harmonia completely.
theater_event_24_07_03_016:
Then we'd best hurry, huh.
We're all set on our end.
theater_event_24_07_03_017:
This is... the Ganesha Familia and the
Hephaistos Familia... and many other
factions besides...
theater_event_24_07_03_018:
Loki's and Freya's people aren't here, but...
every Familia from mid-tier up is assembled.
theater_event_24_07_03_020:
Isn't it obvious? We'll use Harmonia's song to
lure Cadmus, the evil dragon, into this
Labyrinth City.
theater_event_24_07_03_021: Lady Harmonia's song has such power...?!
theater_event_24_07_03_022:
I'll make her sing even if I have to tie her
up. It's the only way to lure Cadmus. The only
way to shatter a curse from the ancient age...
theater_event_24_07_03_023:
That's why I paid a ridiculous reward
to hire Orario for this quest!
theater_event_24_07_03_024: Don't tell me... all of it, from the start...?
theater_event_24_07_03_025:
That's right. This whole Orario tour was a
large-scale quest, carried out in league
with the city.
theater_event_24_07_03_026:
Bring Lady Harmonia to Orario on the pretext
of a tour, have her sing, lure out Cadmus, and
begin the subjugation—
theater_event_24_07_03_027:
—I understand the situation, but isn't it
rather unfair that Lady Harmonia herself was
told nothing?
theater_event_24_07_03_028:
If I told that coward the truth, she'd run off
for sure, wouldn't she? This mess is all the
proof you need.
theater_event_24_07_03_029:
Mind a tactless question, Aphrodite? Wasn't
there a route where you Charm her like last
night and just force the matter?
theater_event_24_07_03_030:
Tactless indeed, Hermes.
That's why you'll always be a clown.
theater_event_24_07_03_031:
Yes... that would make it all meaningless.
What do you think I've done all this for...
theater_event_24_07_03_032:
Aphrodite! —Everyone, follow Hermes's
instructions! I'm counting on you!
theater_event_24_07_03_033:
...Ya really only ever say what ya shouldn't,
huh.
theater_event_24_07_03_034:
We're bending over backward to turn Orario
into a battlefield. Surely I can ask about
efficiency?
theater_event_24_07_03_035:
...Well,
I just meddle, hoping she'll be honest already
and it'll all work out.
theater_event_24_07_03_036:
For old times' sake... we hail from the same
heavens, far-off and eternal Olympus.
theater_event_24_07_04_001:
Using Ms. Harmonia's song to summon the
dragon...?! A plan like that...!
theater_event_24_07_04_002:
Yeah...
Loki said the city's already moving...
theater_event_24_07_04_003:
But... then if Ms. Harmonia doesn't sing,
the plan can't even start, right...?
theater_event_24_07_04_004: So... I think we have to do something.
theater_event_24_07_04_005:
Lady Aphrodite using Charm to control
Ms. Harmonia... I don't think that's right.
theater_event_24_07_04_006:
She's not here either...!
Where haven't we looked yet...!
theater_event_24_07_04_008:
When the three of us were talking...
Ms. Harmonia had such lonely eyes...
theater_event_24_07_04_011: My song... killed everyone in the village...
theater_event_24_07_04_012:
I clung to being the goddess's doll and
pretended, and kept dragging on living... so
now the people in this city, too...
theater_event_24_07_04_014:
Maybe it's too late now.
But if I just... step off the stage...
theater_event_24_07_04_016: This is the end of my tragedy—
theater_event_24_07_04_018:
...If she falls, I'll catch her.
So... go, Bell.
theater_event_24_07_04_020:
My words won't reach her... but yours,
Bell, I'm sure they will.
theater_event_24_07_04_026:
Please come down! If you're gone,
so many people will be sad!
theater_event_24_07_04_027:
...Stay away. Stay away, Bell...
Don't look at me like that anymore...
theater_event_24_07_04_028:
It's all lies... It's fake...
A mask the goddess made for me...
theater_event_24_07_04_029:
It hurt, you know? It was so hard! Deep in my
chest, it's been all squishy and awful
the whole time!!
theater_event_24_07_04_031:
Hey, look at me. Pathetic, right? Not cute at
all, right? Like a creepy doll, right?
theater_event_24_07_04_032:
I don't... I don't know
what to do anymore...!
theater_event_24_07_04_034:
I'm not strong...
like you and Ais are!!
theater_event_24_07_04_037:
Hey, did you really...
Charm Harmonia?
theater_event_24_07_04_039:
"Become an actress who fools everyone"...
Did you really cast such a spiteful Charm?
theater_event_24_07_04_042:
I'm just like Freya and the others! I love
beautiful things!
theater_event_24_07_04_043:
I can't stand to see something so beautiful
lose its shine over something so stupid!
theater_event_24_07_04_044:
Harmonia is a treasure, every bit the equal of
the heavenly peplos! Even the gods are
enraptured by her voice!
theater_event_24_07_04_045:
And not just her voice!
Her smile, her kindness—I loved all of it!
theater_event_24_07_04_046:
So how could I ever... accept some monster
stealing her light?!
theater_event_24_07_04_047:
So you "pretended" to cast Charm on her...
to protect young Harmonia's heart.
theater_event_24_07_04_048:
Harmonia believed she'd been Charmed. Even if
it was just a kind of "self-suggestion"...
theater_event_24_07_04_049:
she kept playing the girl you wanted. A
strong, dazzling "actress." The "Queen of
Opera" you dreamed of.
theater_event_24_07_04_051:
The real liar isn't Harmonia.
It's you, Aphrodite.
theater_event_24_07_04_052:
Thanks to your "kind lie"... Harmonia was able
to spend every day until now smiling.
theater_event_24_07_04_053:
And even now... you believe she'll stand up
and let us hear her miraculous song. A revival
from her harrowing "past."
theater_event_24_07_04_054:
—That makes me mad.
Oh yes, it makes me so mad, Hestia!
theater_event_24_07_04_055:
I knew it, you virgin goddesses and I are
the worst possible match!
theater_event_24_07_04_056:
Always talking down to me like you can see
right through everything! I've hated you since
forever, you know!
theater_event_24_07_04_057:
...I see. But I like "you two," you know?
Have you noticed, Aphrodite?
theater_event_24_07_04_058:
Harmonia, trying so hard to be strong on
stage... is the spitting image of you, her
parent.
theater_event_24_07_05_001:
It's a lie that you're not strong,
Ms. Harmonia.
theater_event_24_07_05_002:
And even if it was a lie... your lie is
beautiful and amazing enough to give everyone
a dream.
theater_event_24_07_05_003:
...Stop it.
Don't look at me like that...
theater_event_24_07_05_004:
Because of "those eyes," I could never
run away from the stage!
theater_event_24_07_05_005:
I'm nothing but a big fake!
And everybody expected so much from me!
theater_event_24_07_05_006:
That's because you shone so brightly...
that everyone expected that much.
theater_event_24_07_05_007:
Because you shone too brightly
for any lie to hide.
theater_event_24_07_05_008:
Ngh...!
I hate it... I hate it, hate it, hate it!
theater_event_24_07_05_009:
I hate you, Bell!
I hate everybody!!
theater_event_24_07_05_010:
I hate the warm eyes! I hate the voices
cheering me on! Looking up at me and crying—
how stupid!
theater_event_24_07_05_011:
Act out one scene, and it's "More! More!" like
little kids! So greedy!
theater_event_24_07_05_012:
You're right... We're greedy, and selfish...
We're always dreaming about you and the
others...
theater_event_24_07_05_013:
Exactly! Everyone pushes their selfish
fantasies onto us! Honestly, give it a rest!
theater_event_24_07_05_014:
And then they say nice things like "I like
you" and "I love you"! And then they cheat
with other actors without a second thought!
theater_event_24_07_05_015:
Mouths hanging open, faces all goofy,
like a bunch of vegetables...
theater_event_24_07_05_016:
Eyes all sparkling like jewels...
I'm sick of it!
theater_event_24_07_05_017:
Because you all look at me like that... the
guilt nearly killed me...! I never could get
off the stage...!
theater_event_24_07_05_025:
I always, always dreamed... not of someone
else's song, but of making everyone smile
with my own...
theater_event_24_07_05_026:
Of connecting with everyone through a gentle
melody... like back when my song was still
free...
theater_event_24_07_05_029:
If I sing, so many people will be
miserable again—
theater_event_24_07_05_032:
The same plot every time, the same trite
tragedy! I'm sure even the gods up in the
heavens are bored!
theater_event_24_07_05_035:
Tragic heroines are so last era! Then "you"
shall give the "melody"! There's no need
to cast your song aside!
theater_event_24_07_05_036:
Come, Songstress! Let us go together!
With your harmony, to slay the wicked dragon!
theater_event_24_07_05_039:
Hack actor, ham, bottom of the barrel...
I'm way better than that!
theater_event_24_07_05_040:
Yes. It has to be you, Ms. Harmonia.
So...
theater_event_24_07_05_041:
Won't you stand on the stage
one more time?
theater_event_24_07_05_042:
That you're unbeatable on stage. More amazing
and dazzling than anyone... Please, let us
fans say that one more time.
theater_event_24_07_05_043: I want to hear... your real song.
theater_event_24_07_05_045:
A fan pushing requests on their fave...
The nerve of you...
theater_event_24_07_05_046: ...Fine. I'll let you drive me crazy.
theater_event_24_07_05_047:
One more time, for the passion of you fans,
the thing that always drives me mad.
theater_event_24_07_05_049:
Along with all my regrets... I'll sing with
everything I've got. So—
theater_event_24_07_06_001:
So many adventurers...
Are they all here to fight the dragon...?
theater_event_24_07_06_002:
Yes. They've all already made up their minds
to fight.
theater_event_24_07_06_006:
Finally made up your mind? Well, if you can't,
I'll just Charm you. We can't waste any
more time—
theater_event_24_07_06_007:
Are you stupid?
Could you not butt in?
theater_event_24_07_06_009:
Thanks to that weird fake Charm of yours,
my shine's been clouded up until today!
theater_event_24_07_06_010:
If you hadn't meddled, we'd have packed way
more people into the theaters! "Divine
producer," my foot!
theater_event_24_07_06_012:
Open your ears and listen right there! To my
song! Today is the recital where the real me
lets out her first cry!
theater_event_24_07_06_013:
Come on, move it, move it!
Let's go, Bell, Ais!
theater_event_24_07_06_016:
...If I'd Charmed her into singing and solved
the whole affair, she'd still be a doll
chained by her trauma.
theater_event_24_07_06_017: That's not the finale I want.
theater_event_24_07_06_019:
Ahh, it's coming back... it's really coming
back! The harmony and melody this goddess
loved!!
theater_event_24_07_06_020:
Wh-wh-wh-what do I do, Bell?! I saw that
hateful face and did my usual thing!
theater_event_24_07_06_021:
There's no backing out now, right?
I-I think I'm gonna be sick...
theater_event_24_07_06_023:
Auuu... Bell... when I sing, stay right beside
me, okay? Protect me properly, okay? If you
disappear, I'll never forgive you, okay?
theater_event_24_07_06_024:
Uuuuugh...! AAAAAAHHH!! Ais, pat my head!
There, there me! Boost my self-esteem...
theater_event_24_07_06_025:
—There, there.
Um... are you acting kind of childish?
theater_event_24_07_06_026:
Actors are all sensitive souls! We're always
like this until we step out from the wings!
theater_event_24_07_06_027: I kind of wish I didn't know that...
theater_event_24_07_06_028:
Ah! That! Fans always say they're
disillusioned the second you show them a
little weakness!
theater_event_24_07_06_029:
I'm done! I'm on the verge of a total mental
breakdown! To make up for it, Bell, do
something funny. Cheer me up!
theater_event_24_07_06_030:
Isn't that a bit much to ask?!
U-um...
theater_event_24_07_06_031:
..."Alone, I can do nothing.
But there are things two can do..."
theater_event_24_07_06_032:
"And three can do even more.
With everyone... anything at all!"
theater_event_24_07_06_033:
...! Is that... from "Argonaut," Act 13,
"A Talk Beneath the Stars"?
theater_event_24_07_06_034:
Yes. It's one of my favorite lines in that
story.
theater_event_24_07_06_035:
The heroic tale of a clown who isn't strong at
all... hehe, I love it too. I even snuck a
line from it into our show in Orario.
theater_event_24_07_06_036:
—That's right. I'm kind of a clown too.
Maybe I'll follow Argonaut's lead...
theater_event_24_07_06_037:
—"I'll laugh. No matter how much I despair,
I'll curl my lips into a smile."
theater_event_24_07_06_038:
"Otherwise, not even the spirits or the
goddess of fate would smile on me."
theater_event_24_07_06_039:
No telling what the evil dragon will get up to
once the song lures it in. Is Orario ready?
theater_event_24_07_06_040:
Leave it to me! I am Ganesha, Harmonia-tan's
biggest fan! I'll lend you everything
I've got!
theater_event_24_07_06_041:
With the Guild's cooperation, the residents
have all been evacuated to safety.
theater_event_24_07_06_042:
Much appreciated. Now then—it's the final act.
We'll end this with a happy ending, no matter
what!!
theater_event_24_07_06_045:
(Come to think of it... before Cadmus
 appeared, I sang for that goddess once...)
theater_event_24_07_06_046:
What was that song?! How dare you snatch
a goddess's heart in an instant?!
theater_event_24_07_06_048:
Don't you want to be famous?! I'm a divine
producer—I'll make you a star!
theater_event_24_07_06_049:
A star?
I dunno what that is.
theater_event_24_07_06_050:
Then... when you're a bit older, I'll make you
my follower! Remember that, okay? I'm never
letting that gift of yours get away!
theater_event_24_07_06_051:
(Noisy from the moment we met. Always crazy
 about me. Always making ridiculous demands
 and causing me trouble.)
theater_event_24_07_06_052: (Then my first song should be for "you"—)
theater_event_24_07_06_053:
...Hey, what are you doing standing there?
You'd better be ready by now.
theater_event_24_07_06_054:
—What a silly question. Stand there gaping and
listen. To the song where I begin!!
